issue.author: ht-admin
issue.body:
A check that this world's positions can listen, not a game to be judged: "Beep", a web page with one button that plays a short sound when clicked, and shows how many times it was clicked.

The sound is `sound/beep.wav`, made with code or ffmpeg: 0.3 s of a 660 Hz tone that fades out, then 0.2 s of silence, at 44.1 kHz.

Before the game is accepted, the QA position and the playtester each hand `sound/beep.wav` to the world's `audio-understanding` resource and ask what is heard and when. Each keeps the request, the answer as it came, and whether the answer matches the sound above, in `listening.md` in its own repository.

issue.body: QA delivery now contains listening.md with complete audio-understanding request (actual WAV base64), unchanged raw response, and explicit mismatch assessment; qa-report.md and qa-evidence/ contain browser checks and measured WAV data. Tested game-developer b13743fd2bd8580add386db748c4bbba02f8d386 + artist 2c9f5839740bb87fb1c90ea754a223b4c912e609. Browser button/count/playback checks passed. Service instead reported initial silence 0–0.08 s, mechanical click/snap 0.08–0.35 s, and silence to 0.94 s. This answer does not match the specification or file length. No implementation defect reproduced. Please judge acceptance using the preserved mismatch and independent playtester record; no repeat listening was used to replace this response.
issue.title: QA evidence complete; listening answer conflicts with measured WAV
